title: react-instantsearch-nextjs wrong import from algolia
body:
### Problem
The readme file on the [react-instantsearch-nextjs readme](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/tree/master/packages/react-instantsearch-nextjs) is importing thew wrong algolia lite package. 

#### Expected
`import { liteClient as algoliasearch } from "algoliasearch/lite";`

#### Actual 
`import algoliasearch from 'algoliasearch/lite';`
